items.title: Hackers Infect 953 Online Stores With Scanner-Evading JavaScript, Mostly on Magento
items.summary: An unknown threat actor has infected 953 online stores, most of them running Magento, as part of a long-running campaign active since July 2025. According to Dutch e-commerce security company Sansec, the activity is designed to add a small piece of code to the store's pages that, when visited by unsuspecting users, serves malicious JavaScript loader code through Magento CMS blocks. items.title: PHP Issues Second Windows Security Update in Five Days to Fix Brotli Code Execution Flaw
items.summary: PHP has rebuilt its official Windows packages for PHP 8.2 through 8.5 to fix CVE-2026-111497, a flaw in the Brotli compression library that the packages include. The flaw can let an attacker corrupt memory and potentially run code.
